def fetch_all_phone_contacts(token):
    contacts = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        contacts.extend(page)
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return contacts

    print(c.get('first_name'), c.get('last_name'), c.get('email'))
